suggested_issue_title: Library CMake build uses -Werror and fails on warnings with GCC 13-15 and Clang 22 (trigraph, unused function)
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-02) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` on 2026-10-09T21:35Z.

## Summary

Building `Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp` with its own CMake files on a non-MSVC compiler fails. `cmake/toolchain-detect.cmake` adds `-Wall -Wextra -Werror`, and committed code produces warnings that are then errors.

## Environment

- Revision `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` (default branch `main`; unchanged since the first observation)
- Docker images `gcc:13` (g++ 13.5.0), `gcc:14` (14.4.0), `gcc:15` (15.3.0) and `silkeh/clang:latest` (clang++ 22.1.8); cmake 3.25-3.31, ninja 1.12; `-std=c++17` as set by the repository

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp
cd Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp && git checkout 9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src gcc:14 bash -c "apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq cmake ninja-build && cd /src/Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp && cmake -S . -B /tmp/b -G Ninja && cmake --build /tmp/b -- -k 0"
```

The README's Development and Testing path (`cd Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp.Tests && cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build`) fails the same way with `gcc:14`.

## Actual result

GCC 13.5.0 / 14.4.0 / 15.3.0, the same three translation units fail:

```
NumberFormat.cpp:30:17: error: trigraph ??/ ignored, use -trigraphs to enable [-Werror=trigraphs]
XlsxWorkbookSerializerCommon.cpp:107:12: error: '...::ElemAttrText(const std::string&, Attrs, std::string)' defined but not used [-Werror=unused-function]
XlsxWorkbookStyles.cpp:233:6: error: 'bool ...::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(const std::string&)' defined but not used [-Werror=unused-function]
cc1plus: all warnings being treated as errors
```

Clang 22.1.8 fails on five files (`NumberFormat.cpp:30` trigraph, `XlsxWorkbookStyles.cpp:233` unused function, `WorkbookProperties.h:83` unused private field `_workbookModel`, `DisplayTextDateFormatSupport.cpp:85,88` string-literal concatenation).

## Where in the repository

- `Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/cmake/toolchain-detect.cmake:4` (`-Wall -Wextra -Werror`)
- `Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/src/aspose/cells_foss/NumberFormat.cpp:30` (the literal `"# ??/??"`; `??/` is a trigraph)
- `Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/src/aspose/cells_foss/XlsxWorkbookSerializerCommon.cpp:107`, `XlsxWorkbookStyles.cpp:233`, `include/aspose/cells_foss/WorkbookProperties.h:83`, `DisplayTextDateFormatSupport.cpp:85,88`

A separate hard compile error (`std::numeric_limits` without `<limits>`) in the same library is reported in its own issue.
